description: Tenant authority for PING. PING is the first tenant on the TenantOS platform model: platform code + tenant configuration + content. A second tenant is a new tenant.*.v1.json plus content, never a fork.

tenant.tagline: More customers found and followed up with for businesses that cannot afford to forget.
tenant.description: PingFyd helps home service businesses get found, get every inquiry answered and followed up, and keep what the business knows in one system that remembers. PING is the system underneath, built and documented in the open.

brand.voice: Concrete, honest, technical. No hype, no vague superlatives. Claims must be demonstrable.

mascot.note: The PING pig: slender metallic gold pig, purple inner ears, purple suit with gold trim. Never a generic pig.

contact.note: Email intentionally unset. Add a real address when one exists; never invent one.

provenance.note: This site was rebuilt from the Happy Place Platform website codebase. Full history is preserved in Git; it does not dominate the public site.
